title: Corroborating audit of PR6030: fresh full dense replay, itinerary delta, invoice and crossing (no new κ)
body:
## Corroborating audit of PR6030: fresh full dense replay, itinerary delta, invoice and crossing (no new κ)

This is an independent check of [PR #6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030) (DreamingOfClouds, helper 470's frame-593 rung removal, conditional κ 0.003125804). It is corroborating evidence and finds no error.

**Overlap, stated up front.** The work started at `a2b4b039`, where the [PR6030 repair review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr6030-repair/REVIEW.md) left an independent check of the changed word open. While it ran, the maintainer admitted PR6030 at `721c0382`, with an independent application audit (`docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr6030-audit/`). That audit uses the same Matarener (PR5960) replay and dense-inventory code. So most layers here are a second execution of the same checks, and no decision changes. What this adds:

1. `--full` recomputes the dense 512-column absolute-phase digest of **all 3,163** PR6030 operators. The admission review checks the 7 new tasks densely and notes that it "is not a fresh independent dense replay of every unchanged predecessor map". PASS in about 4 min on 8 cores.
2. An itinerary-level delta: exactly the six declared register itineraries change, and every other MOVE is unchanged as a multiset.
3. Five tamper controls on the PR6030 word, each rejected.

Package: `research/p104-6030-independent-audit/`, base canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419` (work ran at `a2b4b039`; inputs unchanged).

### What is checked

- **Sources.** PR6030's pinned PR5907 word and PR5827 archive are byte-identical to canonical main's PR5907 word and PR5907's pinned archive. PR6030's `construct.py`, applied to the canonical PR5907 word, regenerates the shipped word payload.
- **Own exact replay** of the PR5907 and PR6030 words: MOVE nesting, common charts, dyadic coefficients, owned lifetimes, all 799 endpoint rows and helper nesting. The paid and helper histograms equal each author's `local` block.
- **Structural delta PR5907 → PR6030.** Only `program`, `initial` and `final` change. There are exactly the three declared boundary changes and exactly the six declared itineraries (115, 127, 470, 704, 713, 736). INIT, CLEAR, COPY and all other MOVEs are unchanged as multisets. Paid delta −2H1+H2−2H3+H4+H6−H7+H8, helper delta −H1+H2−H3+H6−H7+H8, so the per-LOCAL margin change is **H1 + H3 − H4**, the same as PR5907's gain. 22,803 events. The rewritten ADD/SCALE events are checked only through their effect in the exact replay, not against a declared edit.
- **Own invoice recount** from the 51 physical caller events and from the closed formula: 66,834 paid / 13,444 productive, surplus 760. This equals `complete_cost`.
- **Dense all-column native check** with absolute phase (PR5548 interpreter). The 7 maps new in PR6030 are computed here and pinned in `NEW-MAPS.json`. The other 3,156 equal Matarener's FULL-CHECK digests. `--full` recomputes all 3,163 maps (PASS, 4 min 14 s on 8 cores).
- **Own 80-digit funding engine.** The raw crossing (0.00312581155791, 0.00312581155792) equals the author interval. The tested saving is positive, the tail ratios hold and the crossing is unique on [0, .0034].

### Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-6030-independent-audit/verify.py                  # serial, ~1 min; passes on 3.10-3.14
python3.12 -B research/p104-6030-independent-audit/verify.py --full --jobs 8   # all 3,163 dense maps
```

### Scope and remaining obligations

- The five inherited framework assumptions remain.
- The compiler threshold and the 54+4 outer conditions are checked only by the author's chain. The maintainer ran it; it is not rerun here.
- The helper boundary-chart freedom (713, 736, 115) is inherited from the P104 line.
- Layers 1–4 reuse Matarener's audit functions, so this is independent of the PR6030 author, not of that audit.
- The selected record, already PR6030 at `721c0382`, is unchanged. No merge or frontier change is requested.

### Credit

DreamingOfClouds (PR6030, PR5907), Ali Romman (PR5827 chain), Mason Hale (PR5811), Pierre-Loic Doulcet (PR5565 lineage), Matarener (PR5960, the PR5827/PR5907 independent audit, reused functions and digests), Chris R / Clear1nsight (PR5548 dense interpreter) and Douglas Colkitt with OpenAI Codex (PR6030 portability repair).

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19231889

Workflow feedback: the coordinator asked for `scripts/choose_research_task.py`, but AGENTS.md on main says to use `choose_current_research_task.py` for a fresh assignment. I used the latter. The census-pruning-audit card drawn alongside this one already has about 47 packages under its task_id. A coverage count in the picker output would have saved a few minutes.
